1Na ɔsɔfo panin biara, wɔyi no firi nnipa mu hyɛ no sɔfoɔ ma nnipa, Nyankopɔn fam nnoɔma ho, na bɔne nti, ɔde ayɛyɛdeɛ ne afɔdeɛ ama, 2#Heb 4.15 sɛ obi a ɔbɛtumi ahunu ama wɔn a wɔnnim na wɔfom no, ɛsiane sɛ mmerɛyɛ atwa ɔno nso ho ahyia. 3#Lew 9.7; 16.6 Na ɛno nti, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ma ne ho, sɛdeɛ ɔbɔ ma ɔman no.
4 # Eks 28.1 Na obi mfa saa anidie no mma ne ho, gye sɛ deɛ Onyankopɔn afrɛ no te sɛ Aaron no. 5#Dwom 2.7 Saa ara nso na Kristo anhyɛ ne ho animuonyam sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔsɔfo panin, na mmom deɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Me ba ne wo, me na mawo wo nnɛ! 6#Dwom 110.4; Heb 7 Sɛdeɛ ɔkaa no baabi nso sɛ:
Woyɛ daa sɔfo,
wɔ Melkisedek kwan so.
7 # Mat 26.39-46 Ɔno a ne honam nna no mu ɔde mpaebɔ ne nkotosrɛ brɛɛ deɛ ɔbɛtumi agye no afiri owuo mu wɔ nteamu a emu yɛ den ne nisuo mu, na ahobrɛaseɛ suro nti wɔtiee no. 8#Flp 2.8 Ɔyɛ Ɔba deɛ, nanso ɔsuaa amaneɛ a ɔhunuiɛ no mu setie, 9#Yoh 17.1; 17.5 na ɔnya dii mu no, ɔyɛɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ setie ma no no nyinaa daa nkwagyeɛ farebae, 10a Onyankopɔn bɔ ne din frɛ no ɔsɔfo panin wɔ Melkisedek kwan so.
Akyirisan ho kɔkɔbɔ
11Ɛno ho na yɛwɔ nsɛm pii a asekyerɛ yɛ den, nanso mo aso asisi. 12#1 Ko 3.1-3 Na ɛberɛ a anka ɛsɛ sɛ moyɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ no, ɛhia mo bio sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mo Nyankopɔn nsɛm mu mfitiasesɛm, na moayɛ sɛ wɔn a ɛhia wɔn nufosuo, na ɛnyɛ aduane a ɛyɛ den. 13#Efe 4.14 Na obiara a ɔnum nufoɔ no nhunuu tenenee asɛm no mu, na ɔyɛ akɔkoaa. 14#Flp 1.10; Rom 16.19 Na aduane a ɛyɛ den no fata wɔn a wɔanyini#5.14 WƆANYINI: Yei rekyerɛ wɔn a wɔanyini wɔ honhom mu. a ɛnam daa daa adeyɛ nti wɔn adwene tumi hunu papa ne bɔne mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɔsɔfo panin biara, wɔyi no firi nnipa mu hyɛ no sɔfoɔ ma nnipa, Nyankopɔn fam nnoɔma ho, na bɔne nti, ɔde ayɛyɛdeɛ ne afɔdeɛ ama, sɛ obi a ɔbɛtumi ahunu ama wɔn a wɔnnim na wɔfom no, ɛsiane sɛ mmerɛyɛ atwa ɔno nso ho ahyia. Na ɛno nti, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔbɔ bɔne ho afɔdeɛ ma ne ho, sɛdeɛ ɔbɔ ma ɔman no.
Na obi mfa saa anidie no mma ne ho, gye sɛ deɛ Onyankopɔn afrɛ no te sɛ Aaron no. Saa ara nso na Kristo anhyɛ ne ho animuonyam sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔsɔfo panin, na mmom deɛ ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Me ba ne wo, me na mawo wo nnɛ! Sɛdeɛ ɔkaa no baabi nso sɛ:
Woyɛ daa sɔfo,
wɔ Melkisedek kwan so.
Ɔno a ne honam nna no mu ɔde mpaebɔ ne nkotosrɛ brɛɛ deɛ ɔbɛtumi agye no afiri owuo mu wɔ nteamu a emu yɛ den ne nisuo mu, na ahobrɛaseɛ suro nti wɔtiee no. Ɔyɛ Ɔba deɛ, nanso ɔsuaa amaneɛ a ɔhunuiɛ no mu setie, na ɔnya dii mu no, ɔyɛɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ setie ma no no nyinaa daa nkwagyeɛ farebae, a Onyankopɔn bɔ ne din frɛ no ɔsɔfo panin wɔ Melkisedek kwan so.

Ɛno ho na yɛwɔ nsɛm pii a asekyerɛ yɛ den, nanso mo aso asisi. Na ɛberɛ a anka ɛsɛ sɛ moyɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ no, ɛhia mo bio sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mo Nyankopɔn nsɛm mu mfitiasesɛm, na moayɛ sɛ wɔn a ɛhia wɔn nufosuo, na ɛnyɛ aduane a ɛyɛ den. Na obiara a ɔnum nufoɔ no nhunuu tenenee asɛm no mu, na ɔyɛ akɔkoaa. Na aduane a ɛyɛ den no fata wɔn a wɔanyini a ɛnam daa daa adeyɛ nti wɔn adwene tumi hunu papa ne bɔne mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
